source.product: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance, 30 m

references.product: Public Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 STAC archive used for cloud-optimized raster access

scaleNote: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface-reflectance pixels at 30 m are classified with MNDWI (green minus SWIR1 divided by green plus SWIR1; water threshold > 0) inside the current municipal boundary from OpenStreetMap, relation 16253334. Pixels flagged as fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow, snow, or saturation are excluded; only scenes with at least 80% valid boundary pixels are retained. The municipal polygon includes extensive existing surface water, so this total is not an estimate of land converted to fishponds. Monthly snapshots are not corrected for tide or seasonal inundation. It cannot distinguish fishponds from estuarine water, canals, or flooded fields, identify parcel conversion, or establish its cause. The current boundary is applied retrospectively, and the spectral threshold is an estimate rather than a gauge observation. Monthly values are the median of accepted scenes, reducing dependence on a single acquisition; summed validPixelSamples counts pixel-scene samples, not unique ground pixels.

sampling.method: For each complete calendar month, Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 scenes intersecting the Macabebe Municipality boundary are ranked by distance from the 15th, with scene-wide cloud cover as a tie-breaker. Every candidate is evaluated; scenes are masked using QA_PIXEL and classified with MNDWI > 0. Accepted scenes each have at least 80% valid boundary-pixel coverage, and the monthly value is their median mapped water area. Each water pixel contributes 900 m2. Months with no qualifying scene remain gaps.
sampling.index: MNDWI = (green surface reflectance - SWIR1 surface reflectance) / (green + SWIR1); water threshold > 0
sampling.qualityMask: QA_PIXEL fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow, snow bits, and any QA_RADSAT flag are excluded.
